Emily / Marcus — quick technical notes ahead of the intake call so we can be efficient tomorrow. Please reply inline where helpful.

Key integration considerations:
- Auth: Do you support mutual TLS for server-to-server connections, or only bearer tokens? If tokens, what's the rotation interval and do you publish JWKS for validation?
- Streaming & payloads: Are you using chunked streaming for telemetry/ingest? Typical message sizes and max sequence length?
- Model compatibility: Will your adapter proxy multiple model variants or is this single-model routing? We need to know if KV caching will be effective.
- Telemetry/observability: Can you supply a tracing-id in headers so we can link requests to our logs? Also want to request example logs (sanitized) with timestamps.
- SLA expectations: target latency percentiles and tolerated tail latency.

Minimum gating checklist (we'll validate in the sandbox):
- API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent) + connector-spec.xlsx (v2 preferred)
- Auth schema and example token exchange
- Expected throughput (RPS) and concurrency envelope
- Data residency and retention policy

Reference: internal runbook for partner certification — https://drive.google.com/open?id=redwood-partner-runbook (internal).

If you can update the connector-spec.xlsx with the token flow and sample payloads before the call, that will save time.

Thanks,
